# 5 Million Ethiopian Coders

> A government-backed free coding bootcamp initiative providing Ethiopian developers with training in programming, data science, AI, and Android development.

5 Million Ethiopian Coders is a national initiative by the Government of Ethiopia to upskill developers through free bootcamp programs and professional certifications. The platform offers comprehensive training in modern technologies and connects learners with freelancing opportunities.

## Key Topics

- Free Coding Bootcamp
- Ethiopian Developers
- Programming Fundamentals
- Data Science
- AI & Machine Learning
- Android Development
- Skill Certification
- Government Initiative
- Python
- Freelancing
- Learn2Earn
- AI Tools
- Telegram Bot
- Registration
- Upwork & Fiverr

## Getting Started

- [5 Million Ethiopian Coders | Programming, Data Science, AI & Android Development](https://ethiocoders.vercel.app/): Main initiative hub offering free bootcamp in programming, data science, AI, and Android development for Ethiopian coders.

## Certification & Credentials

- [Ethio Coders ET Certification – Get Your Free Certificate Today](https://ethiocoders.vercel.app/certificates): Free ET Certification registration and management for bootcamp participants to validate their skills and enhance professional credentials.
